store.summary: Antenna Lab (NEC2, 3D pattern, beam optimizer) plus band check, RF math, propagation, satellites, POTA/SOTA, ID clock
store.description: From Ask Elmer, askelmer.com. Ham radio tools in your pocket, with Antenna Lab up front. Antenna Lab: model real antennas with the NEC2 engine (dipoles, inverted Vs, OCFDs, end-feds, G5RV, verticals, ground planes, J-poles, Yagis, Moxons, quads, delta and sky loops, small magnetic loops). See feed impedance, SWR across the band, gain, takeoff angle, the pattern in 2D and as a 3D shape you can turn, coax loss to the radio, a beam optimizer, a NanoVNA or .s1p sweep laid over the model, and a cut list. Band check: type a frequency and see the whole band as a bar with each license class's segments, whether you may transmit there, the power limit, the edge, what's usually nearby, and one key to model an antenna for it. RF math: power, dB and S-units, SWR, Ohm's law, LC, toroids and attenuator pads. Where & when: distance and heading to a grid or a call sign, zones, sunrise, sunset and greyline. Propagation: solar data from hamqsl.com plus an offline MUF estimate. Satellites: the next passes of the FM and linear birds with a sky plot and Doppler-corrected frequencies. POTA and SOTA: spots, parks and summits near you (kept offline) and an activation counter. A station clock in UTC with a 10-minute ID timer, and a searchable reference. A GPS gives the time and your location, shared with the other Ask Elmer and Nomad apps; without one, type your grid. Replaces Ask Elmer Shack Tools and Ask Elmer Antenna Lab and keeps their settings. Fn+H shows help.
